verdict.rationale: Vanta documents its own policy capabilities. Its AI Agent drafts policies (vanta-docs-15, vanta-docs-36), policies are stored and listable per framework through the API (vanta-docs-1), and policies can be uploaded programmatically (vanta-docs-23). However, nothing in the pack shows a lawyer-grade template library, an in-app editor, version history, approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking, so only the creation and storage part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: lawyer-grade policy template library, policy editor, versioning, approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
